Retrieves a list of units. This information can be found within the Unit tab of the Vocabulary facet in the Climb UI.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number for the paginated results.  Default is 1.
Setting a number beyond the last page will just return the last page of data.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of items returned for the page. A maximun size of 2000 is set. Default is 20

post.description:
POST /api/vocabulary/unit

Create a unit. This information can be found within the Unit tab of the Vocabulary facet in the Climb UI. Fields that are required in the UI are also required in the API. Note that the field names are case insensitive.
